item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 23 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 23 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:40 AM 05 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(JosePanganiban, Labo, Paracale, Vinzons), #OrientalMindoro(Bongabong, Roxas and Mansalay) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(SantaCruz, Mogpog, Boac), #Romblon(Romblon, Banton, Corcuera, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Calatrava, SantaMaria, Odiongan, SanFernando, Concepcion), #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros, Balud, Aroroy), #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Garchitorena and Caramoan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
